summary: BOEN AS (org. no. 980 400 646) is a private limited company (AS) based in Kristiansand, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1998-12-30. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 16.220 (Produksjon av sammensatte parkettstaver); it has 17 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 211.7 m and net income was NOK 6.2 m. CEO: Jan Nielsen; board chair: Patrick Mathijs Catharina Hardy; auditor: ERNST & YOUNG AS. Also: LEI 636700YG7BOQAFRNO583.
